tracks.name: frontier
tracks.description: Come up with a better witness encryption scheme than Praxis (ePrint 2026/2971) at 100-bit security. Two objectives, a Pareto frontier, lower is better: size, the ciphertext size in MiB, and time, one encryption plus one expected decryption in millions of field multiplications. A submission is a parameter set: code checks with exact arithmetic every condition under which the paper proves the scheme secure, and computes both objectives. A submission may also change the scheme or those conditions, with a full proof that the LLM verifier judges and a person checks before promotion. The paper's parameters score (8073 MiB, 28669 million multiplications): 7.88 GiB, about 2^34.2 to encrypt and 2^33.0 to decrypt.
